maintenance.anti_relocation: Complete AST identities include short definitions; dedicated-file identities preserve all newline bytes on a whole-file move. Imported aliases discover new callers and helpers.
maintenance.cutover: s4_modules must set phase to s4_modules. That expires the 15000 overlap immediately and rejects all legacy journal/duplicate-metadata writers. final uses the same caps.
maintenance.ownership: Review new unknown definitions/imports and storage writers explicitly; add ownership or a precise generic exclusion. Never refresh the baseline from HEAD.
maintenance.snapshots: baseline and landing files/spans record immutable source revisions, not rolling measurements.
maintenance.storage: A writer key includes path, enclosing definition and call AST; enclosing AST changes require another classification review. Ordinary audits are not ref-replay authority.
